_comment: Minimum % of cases where every check passes. Set just under the 26 Nov 2026 baseline (gpt-5.4-mini: triage 100, confirm 100, draft 100 on rule checks) so one flaky case doesn't block a PR, but a real regression does. Only raise these. The groundedness judge (v4) scores 81% (13/16) on its own labelled set; its floor of 75 catches a judge regression, but its verdict on drafts stays advisory (judge_gates_drafts: false) until it clears a larger, fresh labelled set.
